about: IPMA's warnings for the Lisbon district as CAP messages (Common Alerting Protocol), read through MeteoAlarm's public feed (https://www.meteoalarm.org). A dated record, not a live feed: read 2026-11-12T12:44:23Z. MeteoAlarm: "Time delays between this website and the www.meteoalarm.org website are possible. For the most up-to-date awareness information as published by the participating National Meteorological and Hydrological Services, please refer to www.meteoalarm.org." Unlike IPMA's open data, each message carries `sent_utc`, the time IPMA issued it, and `replaces`, the message it updates (with that one's sent time). Every message once seen is kept; one no longer in the feed is marked `left_feed_utc` (the time read). Messages that left the feed before this desk's first read (10 Nov 23:51) were never seen. Facts.

feed_batches_about: Every CAP message in the feed, any level and district, grouped by the time IPMA sent it. COVERAGE: first read 11 Nov 19:27:32 UTC. It is complete only for batches sent from then on. Older rows are only the messages still in the feed at that read: a batch that had left the feed before 19:27:32 is missing, so a gap before then does NOT mean IPMA sent nothing. Before 19:27:32, only lisbon_messages (all levels, from 10 Nov 19:01) and other_messages (red and Madeira from 11 Nov 01:50, orange from 12:36) are complete. messages are keyed identifier|area.
references_note: Each 'replaces' entry keeps IPMA's <references> identifier verbatim. From the batch sent 11 Nov 15:55:03 IPMA's references carry a stray '-' (e.g. '…PT.261111123313.-PO-01-1939' for the message '…PT.261111123313.PO-01-1939'), in the CAP itself as MeteoAlarm serves it (checked 16:15:54 UTC), not from our parser. 'identifier_norm' removes it; 'matches_known_message' says whether the normalised identifier is a message we hold. Match on identifier_norm, or on sent_utc.
other_messages_about: Beyond Lisbon: every CAP message for a Madeira area, and every red message for any district, kept once seen (from 11 Nov 01:50 UTC; earlier ones that had left the feed were never seen); orange messages for any district kept as well from 11 Nov 12:36 UTC (earlier orange ones were not kept).
